name: Trials of the Betwixt
source:
Thrust into a world stuck between life and death, Christopher has been chosen by an entity known as 'The Baron' to unwillingly participate in a trial that could reward him with the contract of his dreams.

[From [url=https://cripticbite.itch.io/trials-of-the-betwixt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克里斯托弗被推入一个生与死之间的世界，被一个名为“男爵”的实体选中，不情愿地参加一项可能奖励他梦想契约的审判。

[来自[url=https://cripticbite.itch.io/trials-of-the-betwixt]itch.io[/url]]
